methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 real, individually re-verified pop-up toasters (2-slice and 4-slice) spanning budget to premium as of mid-2026. Each priceUsd, releaseDate, and headline spec was re-checked against manufacturer pages (Cuisinart, Breville, Smeg, KitchenAid, Revolution Cooking, Black+Decker, Dash, Hamilton Beach) cross-referenced with Amazon, Best Buy, Target, Home Depot, Abt and Walmart listings on 2026-06-19. Slot width is in inches; browning_settings is the integer count of distinct shade positions; bagel_function, defrost_function, high_lift_lever are booleans (true = feature confirmed in manufacturer documentation, null = not confirmable in any source consulted, false = explicitly absent per manufacturer spec). priceUsd reflects the published US selling price for the exact model/config named; where the manufacturer page shows a current sale, the current price is used. A NULL BEATS A GUESS: unverifiable numbers are null. Corrections from the draft: CPT-180P1 price 69.95->59.95 (current cuisinart.com price); Revolution R180 Connect price 299.95->349.95 (the draft's 299.95 'current price' was unsupported; 349.95 is the broadly-corroborated published price). All accessedAt=2026-06-19.
